name: getnestdoc
description: A terminal documentation reader for NestJS.
author: devenock
//typescript: Pinned exact, no caret. 7.x is the native Go port and removes the JS Compiler API (createSourceFile, createProgram). See docs/DECISIONS.md, ADR-0001.
//marked: Runtime dependency of `nest-doc update` only (src/nest/update/), lazy-loaded the same way typescript is — see marked-loader.ts. Left unpinned (caret) unlike typescript: marked's parser API is stable across its majors, this project doesn't touch its Compiler-API-equivalent internals.
//overrides: eslint-plugin-import-x's unrs-resolver pulls in @napi-rs/wasm-runtime, which declares a *range* for @emnapi/core and @emnapi/runtime rather than an exact version. That range resolves to whatever's newest on the registry at install time, so package-lock.json generated on one day (or one platform) can miss a version the registry publishes later or resolves differently on Linux CI — the exact 'Missing: @emnapi/core@X from lock file' failure this pin exists to prevent. Pinning removes the ambiguity outright.
